snippet.title: Space Mayhem - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by classic arcade games, Space Mayhem is a fast-paced score chaser with a retro style. Collect powerups, manage your ammo, obtain massive score multipliers, and blast your way through infinite, chaotic waves of enemies!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/922470/Space_Mayhem
Twitter: https://twitter.com/space_mayhem
